column4: Continue the reference: identical camera, floor and kneeling congregant, but now the glass face on the floor is more than half assembled: the oval outline is complete with the orange hair pieces, one eye and the lower face filled in, the other half still missing with gaps. The congregant is placing one more shard. No text.

Same camera, scale and position as the first reference but she has stopped walking, standing upright with her feet together, her body still facing away from the viewer while her head is turned back over her shoulder so her face is visible in three-quarter view, looking back at the viewer with quiet, steady eyes. the same living librarian as in the reference sheet and portrait: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, white blouse with black ribbon bow and orange brooch, layered black, ivory and orange skirt, ankle boots. She is a living human: natural skin, no ball joints, no wrist rings, no seams. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand, both eyes visible when facing the camera. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it, no strings, no floor, no shadow, no text.

Close-up, horizontal composition, of the new porcelain doll's hanging wrist: her right forearm crosses the frame horizontally from the right edge, with the brass wrist ring and ball joint plain to see in the center. The fingertips of a living librarian's hand with a white cuff, entering from the left, are just touching the ring from the side. Nothing else: no threads, a plain dark coal background with a few paper-white specks. Five fingers on each hand. No text.

The same bare porcelain hand as the reference, now reaching horizontally from the RIGHT edge of the frame toward the LEFT, forearm level, fingers extended and slightly curled open as if offering a hand, ball joints at the knuckles and wrist visible, five distinct fingers. Plain coal-dark background with a few paper-white specks. No threads, no text.

Continue the reference: identical camera and lectern, but now the book is CLOSED, its red cover shut flat on the lectern, and her hand rests on top of the cover pressing it down, fingers flat. Only her hand and forearm. No text.

Extreme close-up of the new porcelain maid doll's face filling the frame from a slight angle: ivory porcelain, her left eye closed with a thick line of lashes, orange hair framing the face, the edge of her flower ornament at the corner. Calm, asleep. Composition of the eye like the second reference icon. Plain flat colors. No text.
